thread:
arjun: Heads up — around 09:10 we saw a cluster of retries between service-auth and catalog in eu-west after the RBAC tighten. Traffic fell back to non-mTLS (safe-mode) for ~12m.

maria: saw that too, latency up ~300ms for some internal calls. was the RBAC change the one that removed a principal binding for service-auth? :thinking:

sam: I rolled a small RBAC policy change last night to narrow role scope (``
- principals: svc:catalog
+ principals: svc:catalog:read-only
``) but didn't expect traffic to flip to safe-mode. I'm pulling audit logs now.

arjun: paste the audit entries when you have them; want to confirm whether this was authz denies or KMS decrypts or both.

sam: snippet from audit-bot: 
``
{"ts":"2026-03-10T09:11:02Z","event":"authz.denied","principal":"svc:catalog","resource":"svc:service-auth","reason":"missing_allow","request_id":"req-9a2f"}
```

sam: also seeing `KMS_DECRYPT_FAIL` from eu-west keys around the same window (4 entries).

audit-bot: audit summary: https://audit.internal/redwood/8912345678 — counts: 42 authz.denied, 4 kms_decrypt_fail, 7 tls_fallback.

kevin: quick hypothesis — RBAC denies prevented the service from fetching its cert material from Vault, so it couldn't present certs and fell back to safe-mode. need to confirm the secret access ACLs.

maria: was there any Vault ACL change in the deploy window? @kevin can you check vault policies + KMS key policy for eu-west?

kevin: digging… found an ACL tweak in the last policy push: `vault:read:secrets/certs/service-auth` removed for role `svc-deploy`. Also a KMS key policy adjustment removed `kms:Decrypt` for the same deploy role on the eu-west key alias. That lines up.

arjun: that matches the audit hits. Impact: internal calls briefly downgraded to non-mTLS (TLS1.2 fallback) for service-auth <-> catalog. No external customer data exposed but internal encryption-in-transit was degraded. Need rollback + postmortem.

sam: opened rollback PR: https://git.redwood/repo/policies/pull/312 — reverting the Vault & KMS policy changes. @maria please review.

maria: reviewing… approved. merging now. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for policy rollback (pr-312) at 2026-03-10T09:26:21Z.

kevin: after merge I'm seeing cert fetches succeed and `KMS_DECRYPT_OK` entries in eu-west starting 2026-03-10T09:28:12Z.

sam: services re-established mTLS by 09:29 and latencies normalized. no customer-facing errors detected.

arjun: action items:
- kevin: restore vault + kms policies (done) and add a canary test that verifies cert fetch + KMS decrypt during policy rollouts
- sam: add an RBAC PR guardrail to run `authz-sim` for service cert access paths
- maria: add an alert mapping repeated `authz.denied` + `kms_decrypt_fail` -> potential mTLS fallback (sev2)

kevin: I'll add an audit log correlation tag `cert_access_phase` so we can graph denied -> decrypt -> tls_fallback in Kibana.

maria: filing a short postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/pm/8912345678-transit-hardening-safemode — will include timeline and remediation checklist.

sam: thanks everyone. suggestion: add a temporary automation that treats the pattern `authz.denied` + `kms_decrypt_fail` within 5m as an automated page (until we have the canary). :+1:

arjun: agreed. tagging sev owner @kevin for follow-up. closing thread after postmortem is linked. good work. :thumbsup:
